messages:
tony-cs: Urgent: NYX Fin just returned a bespoke SIG/CAIQ and set a 48h due. They specifically want KMS/HSM key export logs + proof of 12mo log retention. Questionnaire link: https://secure.docs/nyx-sig-bespoke-041.json. Can eng/sec produce export + chain-of-custody? Ticket #CUST-9321
amar: On it. Clarify: do they want a full HSM attestation PDF or just operational logs (key create/delete/rotate)? Need exact question refs so we don't over-export.
jess-security: They called out CAIQ Q3.4 (Key lifecycle) and Q5.2 (Audit logging). Required: KMS key creation/deletion/rotation logs, HSM vendor attestation for the devices, and mapping of retention buckets. I'll draft evidence bundle. :female_detective: 
lina-eng-sre: We have periodic S3 audit snapshots under redwood-logs/nyx/2024/*. We can run export with: `tools/log-export --customer nyx --range 2023-03-01:2024-03-01 --types kms,hsm`. Note: deleted key events older than 90d live in coldstore; restore window ~12h.
eng-oncall: FYI we saw a burst of 401s from nyx tenant yesterday 03:14–03:22 UTC. Might be related to rotation or misconfigured token. Snippet:```[03:14:07] authd WARN token=xxxx status=401 reason="key not found"
[03:14:20] kms INFO key_lookup id=key-9f2e status=404
[03:14:59] authd ERROR service=rotation uid=svc-rotator status=500```
tony-cs: They flagged those 401s under 'incident history' in the bespoke form. Can we correlate to a key rotation timestamp?
amar: Key rotation for key-9f2e occurred at 03:13:56 UTC — initiated by internal rotation job. I can produce a timeline + SHA256 of exported key metadata. Will need signed HSM attestation for egress.
jess-security: I'll ping the HSM vendor for a signed attestation PDF and assemble the evidence bundle. Also, legal: confirm what we can redact in customer-facing logs (PII) please.
eva-legal: Redaction allowed for IPs and user ids; timestamps and key ids must remain. We'll sign off on the bundle by EOD if no surprises.
lina-eng-sre: Kicking off export now. Command + ETA:
```n
tools/log-export --customer nyx --types kms,hsm --from 2023-03-01 --to 2024-03-01 --out nyx-kms-export-2247654321.tar.gz
ETA ~2h (includes coldstore restore)
```
I'll post MD5 when complete.
security-bot: Incident created INC-2024-1189 for tenant nyx 401 spike; assigned to eng-oncall and amar.
tony-cs: Thanks. Customer asked for confirmation email once export is posted to secure-share. @lina please upload to secure-share and set expiry 7d. CC @eva-legal.
lina-eng-sre: Upload complete: https://secure-share.redwood.internal/nyx/nyx-kms-export-2247654321.tar.gz md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e
amar: Draft timeline + sha256 of metadata: sha256:3a7f9b8c2d4e6f5a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0. DMing HSM vendor contact for signed attestation.
jess-security: Drafted CAIQ responses for Q3.4 + Q5.2; attaching diffs for review. Need eng + legal signoff before sending.
eva-legal: Reviewed. Approve sending. Suggested subject: 'NYX - Supplemental SIG/CAIQ Evidence (KMS/HSM logs + attestation)'.
tony-cs: Sent to customer at 17:48 UTC. Customer replied: 'received, will review' and requested extension to Monday COB. They accepted a 72h extension. Closing here.
